errors.evidence: The start date on the x-axis of the left chart is 15-Apr-21, not 15-Mar-21.
The labels on the x-axis of the left chart are placed monthly (15-Apr-21, 15-May-21, 15-Jun-21, etc.), not every 2 months.
The y-axis is not labeled with a currency unit. Stating that the prices are in dollars is an assumption not supported by the visual information.
The start date of the line is 15-Apr-21, not 15-Mar-21.

errors.text_span: През периода до 15-ти юли 2021 г. цените колебаят между 60 и 70 долара.
errors.evidence: In the period leading up to July 2021, the price clearly rises above 70, reaching approximately 75.

errors.text_span: От 15-ти юли 2021 г. до 15-ти декември 2021 г. се наблюдава постепенно нарастване до около 80 долара.
errors.evidence: This description is a significant over-generalization. The chart shows a major dip to around 62 in August, a peak around 85 in October-November, and another dip to below 70 in December. It is not a gradual increase.

errors.text_span: След това, до 15-ти януари 2022 г., има лек спад до около 70 долара
errors.evidence: This misreads the trend. After the dip in early December 2021 (from ~85 to ~68), the price begins to rise, not fall. It rises from below 70 towards 80 by January 2022.

errors.text_span: достигайки връх над 120 долара около 15-ти февруари 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The peak price, which is close to 130, occurs in early March 2022, not around February 15th.
The description hallucinates the tick labels and the interval on the x-axis of the right chart. The actual labels are 1, 15, 29, 43, etc., which corresponds to an interval of 14, not 16.
The description assumes the unit is dollars, which is not specified on the chart.

errors.text_span: През първите 100 дни цените колебаят между 90 и 110 долара.
errors.evidence: The lower bound of the price fluctuation in the first 100 days is incorrect. The price never drops to 90; its minimum is around 98-99.

errors.text_span: Колебанията по целия период са по-големи в началото и средата, а по-ниски в края.
errors.evidence: This is a qualitative assessment of volatility, which is a form of interpretation beyond simply describing the visual data as requested by the prompt.
